runs-more.about: Forward runs test (NO EFFECT 2026-11-16, CPU A/B over 4 x 4 min each: midfielders in mode 0x0F while their side attacks 8 % -> 7 %, releases kept 85 % -> 81 %): the function 0x61DAC0 picks ONE forward runner per side (mode 0x0F, slot 0x3BCDCA9 + side) among the defenders and midfielders in mode 0x08 (roles 1-23; forwards never). Two brakes are taken off: the cap that stops any pick once func 0x496C20's count reaches max(attack level, 2) now uses at least 4 (0x61DB2D), and the last dice roll (1 in 10, 8 or 4 by the attack and response stats, 0x61E463) always passes. The per-role gates (centre-backs only at attack level 4, defensive midfielders at 3 and over, the stat tests) are kept.

runs-forwards.about: V2 2026-11-18 (forces the pick): the cave now jumps roles 24-32 straight to the accept code 0x61E49D (ESI = candidate: slot[side] = its id) instead of the stat test, V1 gave 0 forward runs in 270 s. V1 text: Forwards as runners (prototype 2026-11-18): the runner picker 0x61DAC0 switches on the role (+0x10, 1-23) with a table; roles 24 and over (forwards) left it at once (CMP EAX,0x16 / JA 0x61E482), so a forward never made the run beyond the last line (mode 0x0F, one runner per side). Measured by writing the slot from outside (pes6r designate -Runner): forwards in mode 0x0F 0 -> 9 % of their rows, 6000 ahead of the ball. Now the JA goes to a cave at 0x5E2A00 that sends roles 24 to 32 to case 5 of the jump table 0x61E614 (the 'other midfielders' stat test at 0x61E0BF) and leaves the rest to 0x61E482. RESULT 2026-11-18 (France-England, 270 s in play): the hook is reached (22 times in 40 s) and forwards get through to the stat test, but forwards in mode 0x0F stay at 0 rows (midfield 3.5 %); the runner slot changes only about 3 times a minute and one forward id was seen in it once. Too weak alone.

speed-x2.about: Game speed x2: frame step 0x3BE1740 = 60 / X with X = 30 (byte 0x3BE14B0), float 0x3BE12AC = X * 256 / 60. 1.5 worked in a match 2026-11-05. The game writes them back when the speed is set again, so pes6r ab re-applies it each phase.

speed-x4.about: HANGS THE GAME (2026-11-16: the game froze 21 s after this patch was applied in a match, main thread looping at 0x4BBB62-0x4BC6ED around the interception prediction, ball +0x1458; it had run 1 h 30 at x2). Do not use. Game speed x4: same three places as speed-x2 with X = 15: frame step 0x3BE1740 = 60 / 15 = 4.0, byte 0x3BE14B0 = 15, float 0x3BE12AC = 15 * 256 / 60 = 64.0. Use with pes6r ab -SpeedPatch speed-x4 and pes6r compare -Speed 4. Watch for steps that are too big for the physics and AI (balls through players, odd turns): compare the metrics of a patch-less run at x4 with one at x2 before trusting an A/B.
